design.help: The default design is built into the application. Files stored under design/ in the file storage override it file by file (the same relative path wins): the invoice.typ template, fonts in fonts/, the logo logo.svg or logo.png, a stamp or signature signature.png. Upload them with `invoice design push <dir>` (or straight into the bucket); changes apply on the next render without a restart; already archived PDFs stay unchanged.
